system.effect:
A collection of bizarre proteins, possibly some sort of exotic virus, biological artifact, artificial compound, or an outright magical creation. When used on a Pokemon as a consumable item, it raises its Attack and Speed by three Combat Stages each, but Enrages and Confuses it.

This item is also used to create Shadow Pokémon, and is consumed in the process of creating one. Acquisition of this item can vary, but the most common method is to extract this gene from a Shadow Pokemon. Berserk Genes are considered an illegal item and can be found on the black market for $10,000, or far more.
